why: Both involve a wiped or lost work and responses that can look like repair, rebuilding, or relocation, so separating watching/repairing from moving after loss is likely hardest.

why.T3-021: The item centers on watching a repeatedly lost logo, maintaining it, and rebuilding/working on it; T3-021's gate covers watching and repairing the work.
why.T3-022: A distinct concept has the logo moved to a new place after it was wiped, which T3-021 does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-021 would miss the move to a new spot after the logo was wiped.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1143468 explicitly moves the logo after it was wiped, satisfying T3-022's relocation-after-loss gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-022; we would lose the relocation after wiping.

why.T3-105: The item posts Lilac appearances, a final image, and a link dump for future use, matching saving/sharing the work as it stood.
why.T3-009: It also celebrates the finished/immortalized final Lilac, which T3-105 does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-105 records the final image but does not carry the celebratory 'we did it/immortalized' framing.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0967920 and C1020140 celebrate the final image as achieved and immortalized, satisfying T3-009.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-009; we would lose the celebration of the finished work.

why.T3-028: Scripts and bots are written, shared, run, troubleshooted, and used to place/keep the logo, so T3-028 leads.
why.T3-070: Coordinates, templates, overlays, and hand-placement guides are also central, which T3-028 does not carry.
why.T3-014: Discord setup and invites are present as a distinct planning venue, which neither script-running nor template-sharing covers.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-028 misses the coordinates, templates, and overlay guidance used for hand placement.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1150908 and C0947008 give coordinates/templates for placers to follow, satisfying T3-070.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-070; we would lose the hand-placement directions.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-028 misses moving planning into a Discord chat and sharing invites.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0297275, C0800120, and C0521727 set up and invite members to a Discord for the logo.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-014; we would lose the Discord planning venue.

why.T3-004: The concepts share snapshots and then judge Lilac's look, shields, and eye placement, which is settling the mark's design.

why.T3-040: The item is built around apologies to Monster Hunter/Liquicity for overlapping logos and acceptance/repair of relations.

why.T3-029: Most concepts mourn or remember Lilac after the loss, matching T3-029.
why.T3-031: A distinct run of ice-cream and severed-head jokes extends the room's in-jokes, which mourning does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-029 captures mourning but misses the sustained joking consolation in the room's own idiom.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0786067, C0322123, and C1265222 play the ice-cream/severed-head jokes as running room jokes.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-031; we would lose the joking consolation.

why.T3-070: The item coordinates the rebuild with locations, reference images, and templates, matching T3-070.
why.T3-028: Bot recruitment and target updates are a distinct script/bot placement act, which T3-070 does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-070 does not carry recruiting Node.js users or updating a bot target.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1248787 recruits users to run a placement bot, satisfying T3-028.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-028; we would lose the bot placement coordination.

why.T3-009: The concepts celebrate the finished final image with 'we did it', pride, and love.

why.T3-105: The item shares a timelapse, direct link, and high-quality version of the logo as a record.
why.T3-147: It also shares and remarks on Facebook and EDMSauce coverage, which the record-sharing theme does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-105 keeps the work as a record but misses press/viral coverage of it.

why.T3-004: The concepts share snapshots and judge Lilac's look, shields, and eye placement, settling the mark's design.
